'''Jose''' is a character in the [[Grand Theft Auto]] series who appears as a minor character in [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]. Jose is a member of the [[Varrios Los Aztecas]] gang.

==Character history==
Jose, at an unknown time, joined the [[Varrios Los Aztecas]] and became a friend of the [[Gang Leaders|gang's leader]] [[Cesar Vialpando]]. He confronts [[Carl Johnson|Carl "CJ" Johnson]], Cesar's brother-in-law-in-courtship, who [[Cesar Vialpando (mission)|won a lowrider challenge]], ordering him to "fuck off". Cesar, however, vouches for Carl and Jose walks away to find some alcohol. He may or may not have been killed when the [[Los Santos Vagos]] took control of [[El Corona]], [[Little Mexico]] and [[Unity Station]] following the events of [[The Green Sabre]].

==Trivia==
*The voice actor of Jose also voices a [[Los Santos Vagos]] gangster in the mission [[Running Dog]], where [[Grove Street Families]] defaulter [[Big Smoke|Melvin "Big Smoke" Harris]] calls one of the gangsters in the mission Jose.
